items.description: Elevated RB Salvon Ahmed and DB Elijah Jones from the practice squad to the active roster.
Reinstated S Jalen Thompson from injured reserve. Elevated RB Jashaun Corbin from the practice squad to the active roster.
Placed RB J.K. Dobbins on the reserve/suspended list. Signed DT Khalen Saunders to the practice squad.
Placed DL Skyler Gill-Howard on injured reserve. Elevated DE Anthony Lucas from the practice squad to the active roster.
Waived DE Tanoh Kpassagnon from injured reserve. Signed DB Corey Thornton from Carolina's practice squad.
Signed T Wanya Morris from Dallas' practice squad. Designated CB Cam Taylor-Britt to return from injured reserve.
Designated LB Patrick Johnson to return from injured reserve.
Reinstated OL Justin Dedich and DL Kobie Turner from injured reserve. Elevated WR Brennan Presley from the practice squad to the active roster.
Signed P Jack Browning from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed DE Max Llewellyn to the practice squad.
Designated WR Romeo Doubs to return from injured reserve.
Designated DT T'Vondre Sweat to return from injured reserve.
Elevated LB Mason Reiger and DB Cole Wisniewski from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed DT Gabe Hall from the practice squad to the active roster.
Claimed QB Kedon Slovis off waivers from Baltimore.
Released QB Aaron Rodgers.
Claimed DB Avery Smith off waivers from Seattle.

Reinstated CB Nate Hobbs from injured reserve. Signed WR Brandin Cooks to the practice squad. Placed RT Colton McKivitz on injured reserve. Designated OL Austen Pleasants to return from injured reserve.
Designated WR Jalen McMillan and LB Christian Rozeboom to return from injured reserve. Signed CB Brandon Johnson to the practice squad.
Agreed to terms with WR Brandon Aiyuk on a practice squad contract.
Designated OLB Thomas Incoom to return from injured reserve. Released DT Cam Horsley from the practice squad.
Designated OL Patrick Mekari to return from injured reserve.
Signed DT Junior Tafuna and WR Daniel Sobkowicz to the practice squad. Released RB Dare Ogunbowale from the practice squad.
Signed G Nick Broeker to the practice squad.
Claimed DB Isaac Yiadom off waivers from Washington.
Designated RB Raheim Sanders to return from injured reserve.
Suspended RB J.K. Dobbins one game for conduct detrimental to the team. Designated RB Tyler Badie to return from injured reserve.
